user.title: Step 1/3: WeLock cloud login
user.description:
Log in with your WeLock app account. The cloud is only used to load your locks and, when unlocking, to compute the one-time unlock command.

**Note:** every login ends other sessions of this account, e.g. the WeLock app on your phone. Make sure the app is not in use right now.

select.title: Step 2/3: Select lock
select.description: Choose the BLE module of your lock. 'In range' means a Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome Bluetooth proxy of Home Assistant can currently connect to it.

verify.title: Step 3/3: Bluetooth check
verify.description:
Home Assistant will now connect to **{name}** ({address}, lock {device_number}) and request battery and challenge. **No unlock command is sent.**

Wake the lock up (touch the knob) and press Submit.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate WeLock account
reauth_confirm.description: The WeLock cloud rejected the login for {username}. Enter the current password. This ends other sessions of the account (e.g. the WeLock app).

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the WeLock cloud (clientapi.welock.com.cn).
error.cloud_error: The WeLock cloud rejected the request.
error.no_locks: No lock with a Bluetooth module was found in this account.
error.not_in_range: No Bluetooth adapter or proxy of Home Assistant can reach the lock. Move a Bluetooth proxy closer or wake the lock up and try again.
error.ble_failed: The lock did not answer the status request. Wake the lock up and try again.
error.lock_not_found: This lock is no longer part of the WeLock account.

abort.not_in_account: The discovered lock is not part of this WeLock account.

data.battery_interval: Read battery over Bluetooth every (hours, 0 = only when unlocking)
data.local_unlock: Use stored commands for offline unlocking (experimental; also available as the Offline unlock switch)

fetch_access_log.name: Fetch access log
fetch_access_log.description: Fetch the lock's access log from the WeLock cloud. This ends other sessions of the account (e.g. the WeLock app).

page_size.name: Number of entries
page_size.description: How many of the most recent access-log entries to fetch.

import_commands.name: Import command table
import_commands.description: Add unlock commands from a JSON table file to the lock's local command cache. Existing commands are never overwritten. This does not switch offline unlocking on.

path.name: File
path.description: Path of the table file, relative to the Home Assistant configuration folder.

clear_commands.name: Clear stored unlock commands
clear_commands.description: Forget all stored unlock commands of every lock. The table fills again from the cloud's answers; until then offline unlocking has nothing to use (unless you import a table again).

unlock_too_soon.message: Please wait {wait} s: at least {min_interval} s must pass between two unlocks.

lock_busy.message: The lock is currently busy with another operation.

lock_not_in_range.message: No Bluetooth adapter or proxy of Home Assistant can reach the lock right now.

import_path_not_allowed.message: The file path is not allowed: it must be a .json file inside the Home Assistant configuration folder.

import_file_unreadable.message: The command table file could not be read ({error}).

import_invalid_table.message: The command table is not valid: {error}.

import_wrong_lock.message: The command table belongs to a different lock; no loaded WeLock entry has this device number.

lock_unreachable.title: {name} has been out of Bluetooth range
lock_unreachable.description: Home Assistant has not reached {name} over Bluetooth for more than {hours} hours. Check the Bluetooth adapter or proxy near the lock and the lock's battery. Unlocking works again as soon as the lock is in range.

battery_low.title: {name}: battery is low ({percent} %)
battery_low.description: The battery of {name} is at {percent} %. Replace the batteries soon so the lock does not fail.

poor_connection.title: Poor Bluetooth connection to {name}
poor_connection.description: Connecting to {name} takes about {seconds} s and {failures} of the latest attempts failed. Move the Bluetooth adapter or a Bluetooth proxy as close to the lock as possible (in tests, 20 cm instead of 50 cm made connecting about 2.5 times faster), and away from metal and USB 3 ports.
